support_claim: Commercial notes record that Oakfield Logistics GmbH rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH with unchanged registration HRB 88421, and MSA-OAK-2018 names Oakfield Logistics GmbH as counterparty.
justification: Under the identity contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet ties the contract counterparty name to the billing entity via an explicit rebrand with unchanged legal registration, not merely name similarity or compatibility; no evidence establishes distinctness, and the packet does not preserve competing candidates or flag identity as unestablishable.
